name: Starlit Hunting Dark
introDiscord: The darkness ahead is filled with tiny stars. Unfortunately, several of those stars are attached to Starlit Viperfish.
introTwitch: The darkness ahead is filled with tiny stars. Unfortunately, several of those stars are attached to Starlit Viperfish.

starlit-hunting-dark-approach.prompt: Three routes disappear into a field of beautiful lights that absolutely cannot be trusted.

left.message: A cometglass seam sparkles beneath the darkness. You verify it has no teeth before approaching.

right.message: Shizuki's tonic reads: "If star moves toward you: fish. If star opens mouth: definitely fish."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic untouched and memorize the extremely advanced identification system.

forward.message:
A beautiful star drifts closer.

It smiles.

Stars should not smile.

starlit-hunting-dark-depths.prompt: The hunting dark thickens. Three paths are marked only by moving points of light.

left.message: A constellation rearranges itself into one extremely hungry Viperfish.

right.message:
A Berry floats beside Shizuki's abandoned telescope.

"Telescope update: excellent at locating stars. Unfortunately excellent at locating fish pretending to be stars."

forward.message:
A star-chart coffer rests beneath a cluster of genuine stars.

Probably.

starlit-hunting-dark-threshold.prompt: Gleaming Abyss waits beyond three corridors filled with slowly approaching lights.

left.message: A meteor-iron reliquary glints beneath the seabed.

right.message:
One light rushes toward you.

You don't even bother calling it a star anymore.

forward.message: Shizuki's emergency bottle is labeled: "Astronomy-related bite treatment."
forward.fullHpMessage:
"The astronomy-related bite treatment remains unnecessary. Excellent."

BOSS:

boss-antechamber.name: Gleaming Abyss
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every small light suddenly disappears.

One enormous star remains.

bossPromptDiscord:
The lone star opens an enormous jaw.

That answers that.

Use /yes to enter Gleaming Abyss or /no to permanently distrust celestial objects from a safer distance.
bossPromptTwitch:
The lone star opens an enormous jaw.

That answers that.

Use !yes to enter Gleaming Abyss or !no to permanently distrust celestial objects from a safer distance.
bossRetreatText: You retreat. The enormous false star follows briefly, then disappears into the dark.

boss.revealText:
The brilliant lure splits around rows of enormous teeth.

Nova-Fang Viperfish reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Nova-Fang vanishes.

Real stars slowly become visible again.

You inspect every single one suspiciously."
